subject: heavy iron collar and dragging chains
fact: The heavy iron collar and dragging chains were used by the Fire Temple warlock to control and goad the Chimera into battle, and were later found stamped with the marks of Nulb's River Pirates, revealing that someone in Nulb was paid to deliver the monster.
source_quote: A heavy iron collar and dragging chains used by the Fire Temple warlock to control and goad the Chimera into battle. The chains were later found to be stamped with the marks of Nulb's River Pirates, revealing that someone in Nulb was paid to deliver the monster.

subject: Warlock's Ledger
fact: The Warlock's Ledger is a document found on the Fire Temple warlock, containing a heavy wax-sealed receipt bearing the crest of a crimson ship, a bill of sale from Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader detailing the purchase of the chimera, paid in full by the Fire Temple, and revealed a connection to Vesrek, an ally of the Water Temple's prophet Belsornig.
source_quote: A document found on the Fire Temple warlock, containing a heavy wax-sealed receipt bearing the crest of a crimson ship. It is a bill of sale from Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader detailing the purchase of the chimera, paid in full by the Fire Temple. It also revealed a connection to Vesrek, an ally of the Water Temple's prophet Belsornig.

subject: Fire Temple Amulet
fact: The Fire Temple Amulet is a heavy gold amulet and chain depicting the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple, found on the warlock, with craftsmanship and gold weight making it worth 100 gold pieces.
source_quote: A heavy gold amulet and chain depicting the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple, found on the warlock. Its craftsmanship and gold weight make it worth 100 gold pieces.

subject: Potion of Fire Resistance
fact: The Potion of Fire Resistance is a magical elixir found on the warlock, intended to protect the user from heat and flames, which the warlock had on his person but panicked and never reached for it during the chaos of the chimera's rampage.
source_quote: A magical elixir found on the warlock, intended to protect the user from heat and flames. The warlock had it on his person but panicked and never reached for it during the chaos of the chimera's rampage.

subject: Masterwork Whip
fact: The Masterwork Whip is a high-quality whip woven with alchemically treated red leather, found among the warlock's belongings, featuring a ten-foot reach and capable of slowing an enemy's movement.
source_quote: A high-quality whip woven with alchemically treated red leather, found among the warlock's belongings. While not magical, it is of fine craftsmanship, features a ten-foot reach, and can slow an enemy's movement.

subject: Eldritch Blast
fact: Eldritch Blast is beams of crackling energy fired by the Fire Temple warlock at Sequioa, dealing significant damage early in the fight.
source_quote: Beams of crackling energy fired by the Fire Temple warlock at Sequioa, dealing significant damage early in the fight.

subject: Healing Word
fact: Healing Word is a quick divine incantation used by Calmer on two separate occasions during the battle — first to restore Sequioa to consciousness, and later to bring Zephyr back from the brink of death.
source_quote: A quick divine incantation used by Calmer on two separate occasions during the battle — first to restore Sequioa to consciousness, and later to bring Zephyr back from the brink of death.

subject: Toll the Dead
fact: Toll the Dead is a necrotic spell cast by Calmer that manifests as the sound of a melancholy tolling bell, used multiple times during the fight and ultimately delivered the final, fatal blow to the wounded Chimera.
source_quote: A necrotic spell cast by Calmer that manifests as the sound of a melancholy tolling bell. It was used multiple times during the fight and ultimately delivered the final, fatal blow to the wounded Chimera.
